issues.on_page: Combining Statement - General Fund, Inheritance Tax Fund column: Inheritance tax 640,237; General government 301,104; Public welfare & social services 29,700; Culture and recreation 30,000; Capital outlay 399,694 (Total disbursements 760,498); Transfers - out (503,241)
issues.issue: [fixed] The Inheritance Tax Fund (part of the General Fund) is not in detail[]. The p11 budget schedule only covers the General Fund column, so these lines are printed only on p5 and are not a double count. Without them, detail revenue is 640,237 short of the statement's 11,724,481, and detail transfers out (3,146,612) are 503,241 short of the 3,649,853 transfers in. The notes mention the fund but it was never recorded. Add these lines and their detail_totals (revenue 640,237, expenditure 760,498).
The category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The report prints it under Public Works, so streets/highways is defensible; already marked review.
